0022600085.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Atlanta Hawks visit the Orlando Magic. Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Orlando is without Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring). The Hawks won all four of their 2025-26 meetings with the Magic, including a 130-101 win in Orlando on April 1, 2026.
